name: Reference states
description: Independent reference states for calibrating orbit uncertainty: precise orbits read from SP3 (files/orbit-products) become GCRF/UTC states per catalogued object, with the product's stated accuracy as covariance and its provenance; compare_to_reference scores an ephemeris and its covariance against them ($OEM residuals, $CVR realism). Typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only. The SP3 satellite identities (product, source, satellites.<SP3 id>.{norad, objectId, name}, optional statedSigmaM with statedSigmaBasis) are node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (SDS $PIV, one ModuleConfig). No credentials: capabilities none.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic transform of caller-supplied precise-orbit states and Earth orientation. One plugin.getConfig hostcall (the identities); no threads, propagation or network access.

inputPorts.description: $OEM from files/orbit-products read_container of one SP3 file: one block per satellite, Earth-fixed (ITRF realization), in the file's time system, positions with SP3 standard-deviation exponents.
$NCD from the same read_container call: the SP3 header (agency, coordinate system, base, per-satellite accuracy) and the file's SHA-256.
$EOP rows bracketing the file's span (one row, several frames, or a size-prefixed stream), as foundation/frames reads them.

outputPorts.description: One $OEM per identified satellite: GCRF states in UTC, velocity from the degree-9 Lagrange interpolant of the positions, covariance from the stated accuracy, provenance in COMMENT.

methods.displayName: Compare an ephemeris to reference states

inputPorts.description: $OEM, block 0: TEME (TEMEOFDATE) or GCRF, UTC, states and optional covariance lines in the same frame (for example a COMSPOC SynCoPate file read by files/orbit-products 0.1.4).
$OEM, block 0: GCRF or EME2000, UTC, EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES: the reference states, compared at their own epochs.

outputPorts.description: $OEM, one GCRF/UTC block: per reference epoch inside the ephemeris span, the position error (reference minus ephemeris, km) as the line's X/Y/Z, and with covariance the ephemeris's GCRF position covariance (km^2) as a covariance line at the same epoch; the Mahalanobis distance squared and the GCRF sigmas follow from the two. COMMENT states the frames, degree and counts.

$CVR covariance-realism summary: MEAN_D2_OVER_3 and COVERAGE_95 (d2 <= 7.8147, chi-square 3 dof at 0.95) over SAMPLES epochs with covariance (NaN and 0 without), TEST_WINDOW the compared span, MEASURED_LINEAGE the frames, EVIDENCE the degree and compared / outside-span counts.
